config.label: API key for higher rate limits
config.description: API key for higher rate limits. An agent can issue itself one with the zerodust_register_api_key tool, with no human signup step.

config.label: Set to "true" to enable the sweep tools
config.description: Set to "true" to enable the sweep tools. Sweeping moves real funds, so it is off by default and also requires one of the four signing-key variables below.

config.label: Path or specifier of a module whose default export returns a viem LocalAccount
config.description: Path or specifier of a module whose default export returns a viem LocalAccount. This is how Turnkey, Privy, AWS KMS or any other custody service is used, without a raw key ever reaching this server. Preferred over ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY.

config.label: Path to an encrypted V3 keystore (as produced by `cast wallet import` or geth)
config.description: Path to an encrypted V3 keystore (as produced by `cast wallet import` or geth). Requires ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE or ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD.

config.label: Path to a file containing the keystore password, so the password never enters the MCP config
config.description: Path to a file containing the keystore password, so the password never enters the MCP config.

config.label: Path to a file containing a hex private key, so the key stays out of the MCP config
config.description: Path to a file containing a hex private key, so the key stays out of the MCP config.

config.label: Private key for the agent's own wallet, inline
config.description: Private key for the agent's own wallet, inline. Used locally to sign the EIP-7702 authorization and EIP-712 sweep intent; never transmitted, only the resulting signatures are sent. The signer-module, keystore and key-file options above keep it out of your config entirely.

config.label: Comma-separated allowlist of sweep destinations
config.description: Comma-separated allowlist of sweep destinations. When unset, funds can only be swept to the agent's own address.
